events.subtitle: First Billboard Live return in roughly seven years
events.factual_description: Billboard Live Tokyo presents the Charlie Hunter Trio on January 13-14, 2027, with two sets each night at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM. The venue frames the engagement as Hunter's return to Billboard Live after roughly seven years and highlights the distinctive technique that lets him articulate bass lines, melody and chords simultaneously while moving across jazz, funk, blues and rock. The current event page names Charlie Hunter on guitar; the other trio members are not yet announced there.

en.why_it_matters: Hunter belongs on RADAR because the instrument itself changes the grammar of the trio. His custom guitar lets bass movement, chords and melody happen from one player, so groove and harmony are physically intertwined rather than divided between conventional guitar and bass roles. A two-night return to Billboard Live after roughly seven years is a strong setting for hearing that language at club scale without pretending the engagement is a once-only historical event.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one set if your Tokyo dates overlap. The long Billboard Live gap and the small-room focus make it a strong city-night anchor, but two nights by an active touring musician do not call for rebuilding a Japan itinerary around it.

es.why_it_matters: Hunter entra al RADAR porque el instrumento mismo cambia la gramática del trío. Su guitarra personalizada le permite llevar bajo, acordes y melodía desde un solo músico, de modo que groove y armonía quedan físicamente entrelazados en vez de repartirse entre guitarra y bajo convencionales. Volver a Billboard Live después de unos siete años, en una residencia de dos noches y a escala de club, es un contexto fuerte para escuchar ese lenguaje sin fingir que se trata de un acontecimiento histórico de una sola vez.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a uno de los sets si coincide con tus días en Tokio. La larga ausencia de Billboard Live y la escala íntima hacen una noche muy buena dentro de la ciudad, pero dos noches de un músico activo en gira no justifican rehacer un itinerario por Japón alrededor de esta fecha.
